Name: Custom Achievements Vanilla
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
This mod adds over 30 in-game achievements! Thanks to the framework from aedenthorn, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10047]Custom Achievements[/url]!

Achievements all have random icons provided by the game itself (sunglasses and stuff).

Included are all Steam achievements that don't show up in your collection tab, plus several new achievements (see below).

Everything is doable without any added mods. You do not need more NPCs, cooking recipes, fishes, crops, locations et cetera.

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Can be installed or uninstalled at any point. On your first day after installing, at 6:10AM, some achievements may retroactively be achieved.

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10047]Custom Achievements[/url] v0.4, the main requirement for the mod, there is pagination for achievements, so it cannot interfere with other mods that add more achievements. The only other modded achievement I have in my game is from Stardew Aquarium, which is compatible. Other expansions do not add achievements as far as I know. If you want to play with all 33 achievements, it will create a new page. However, because of the difficulty of the last three achievements, the last category of achievements, [b][i]Other Steam achievements without icons[/i][/b], is turned off by default, but can be activated in the config.

[size=3][b]Achievements[/b][/size]
The following achievements are added. Everything marked (★) is not implemented yet but perhaps in the future. The title and description are all visible before achieving, so they are not masked as spoilers below.
They can be categorized broadly in six categories. Every category can be disabled in the config menu.

[size=3][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
A few achievements were not possible to test (I can't have a test save file for all these possibilities), so feedback is very welcome to potential fixes.
More achievements will be added in the future, especially the ones marked above.
Achievements will receive rewards later (if vanilla does not already reward you, e.g. winning the egg hunt), for now the reward is dopamine only.
There may also come conversation topics for some achievements (if vanilla does not already have them, e.g. winning the egg hunt).
A config option to disable each achievement individually will come later.
There may also come harder achievements, but priority is potential bugfixes plus the already planned achievements.
Achievements may get custom icons if I want to practice pixel art.
I am not planning to add achievements that require mods such as catching 200 different fish, finishing a story-mod such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32356]this one[/url] or reaching a new area added by a mod.
